answer: An adversarial discriminator gate screens every submission. The ledger trains a classifier on text from previously caught farms, learning the saffron telltale of templated prose, then scores each answer's sybil-ness. Posts above threshold are auto-slashed, and the model retrains on fresh catches so it never goes stale. A farm cannot blend in: its crystal of cloned lines trips the detector, and the horizon of safe posting shrinks as the classifier learns. Attacker cost: produce genuinely distinct reasoning per identity that fools a living detector, not one reused paraphrase.
